items.html: And behold, at the time of the morning prayer, that coupling is very lofty, for it is the coupling of Jacob with Rachel; and in particular they draw from the externality of Atik. And behold, everything is empty and lacking, and it is impossible to draw everything at once, that ZA would be completed from all these levels up to Atik. For behold, when we wrote above that he draws from Atik, there is no doubt that all the more so he draws from all these levels; however, he must be completed in them little by little.
